artifacts.summary: Diagnoses run-all.sh's apparent flake as two confirmed, 100%-deterministic (not race-condition) fixture-staleness defects: test-validate-return-meta.sh depends on a live specs/ task directory archived by /todo on 2026-08-17, and test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh asserts a skill_cleanup() contract that was deliberately changed the same day. task-lock.sh and run-all.sh are reviewed and found sound; both offending tests were reproduced standalone with zero concurrent load, and a validated isolation fix is provided for each.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's shell-test-suite (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/), the established isolation idiom for any suite that needs task-lock.sh/state-write.sh/etc. is to copy those scripts into a per-suite mktemp -d scratch tree ($WORKDIR/.claude/scripts/{,lib/}) and point PROJECT_ROOT/REPO_ROOT at the scratch root before invoking them (see test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh's build_fixture_repo()). validate-return-meta.sh and return-meta-artifacts-lib.sh both honor a REPO_ROOT env var override for path resolution, so the same pattern works for return-meta validation tests too. A suite that resolves an artifact path against the live specs/ tree instead (as test-validate-return-meta.sh did before this fix) will break the moment /todo archives or a vault operation renumbers the referenced task directory.

Apparent 'flake' in run-all.sh across different runs/sessions can be caused by ordinary test-fixture bit-rot rather than concurrency races: a test hardcoding a live specs/NNN_* path breaks when that task is later archived, and a test asserting an old contract of a function breaks silently when the function is deliberately changed without updating its test in the same commit. Both reproduce 100% deterministically standalone (no concurrent load needed) and were confirmed by direct execution plus git-blame of the divergence commit. Before attributing suite non-determinism to lock contention, check whether the failing suite touches the live specs/ tree or exercises a function whose header comment/git history shows a recent deliberate contract change.
